name: design-dna
description: Turn a visual reference into an evidence-backed, editable, persistent template; rebuild it measurably; adapt it without drift, verified against the approved baseline.

interface.shortDescription: Scan a design into a verified, editable template
interface.longDescription: Measure a poster, ad or social post into an editable scene model with evidence for every value, rebuild it in a pinned renderer, and apply later edits as verified transactions that keep everything else unchanged.
defaultPrompt: Scan this design and save it as a template
Change only the headline and keep everything else
